", "31": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "32": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "33": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "34": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,", "35": "data:image/svg+xml;base64,"};
function styleImage(g){let a=artworks.find(x=>x.id===styleArtworkMap[g.id]);return {a,src:a?a.img:styleFallbacks[g.id]}}
function styleThumbnail(g){let v=styleImage(g);return `<span class="style-thumb"><img src="${v.src}" alt="${v.a?E(v.a.title):'Original illustration for '+E(g.name)}"/><small>${v.a?'CC0':'ILLUSTRATED'}</small></span>`}
function styleHero(g){let v=styleImage(g);return `<figure class="style-hero"><img src="${v.src}" alt="${v.a?E(v.a.title):'Imaginary '+E(g.name)+' teaching scene'}"/><figcaption>${v.a?`<b>${E(v.a.title)}</b><br>${E(v.a.artist)} · ${E(v.a.date)}<br><span>Image: The Met, Open Access, CC0.</span><br><a href="${v.a.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Actual collection work ↗</a>`:`<b>${E(g.name)}: original teaching illustration</b><br><span>Imaginary scene, not a named artwork or historical building.</span>`}</figcaption></figure>`}
function explore(){let gs=galleries.filter(g=>(filter==='All'||g.medium===filter)&&(!search||(g.name+' '+g.region+' '+g.people).toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Explore the world of art</div><h1>Choose a gallery</h1><p class="muted">Movements, periods and living traditions. Dates are approximate learning guides, not hard borders.</p>${nav()}<label class="sr" for="search">Find a style, region or artist</label><input id="search" placeholder="Find a style, region or artist" value="${E(search)}"><div class="buttons filter four">${['All','Painting','Architecture','Sculpture'].map(f=>`<button data-filter="${f}" class="${filter===f?'selected':''}">${f}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="grid">${gs.map(g=>`<button class="list-card ${allowed(g)?'':'locked'}" data-g="${g.id}" ${allowed(g)?'':'disabled'}>${styleThumbnail(g)}<span>${E(g.name)}<small>${E(g.dates)} · ${E(g.region)}</small><small>${state.badges.includes(g.id)?'Badge collected':allowed(g)?'Explore & play':'Complete the previous trail stop'}</small></span></button>`).join('')||'<p>No gallery matches. Try another search.</p>'}</div><footer>Journey order is a learning route. Global traditions overlap and are not ranked by importance.</footer>`);$('#search').oninput=e=>{search=e.target.value;let pos=e.target.selectionStart;explore();$('#search').focus();$('#search').setSelectionRange(pos,pos)};document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{filter=b.dataset.filter;explore()});document.querySelectorAll('[data-g]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>lesson(+b.dataset.g))}
function lesson(id){gallery=galleries[id];let g=gallery;shell(`<button class="ghost" data-route="explore">← Galleries</button><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">${E(g.region)} · ${E(g.dates)}</div><h1>${E(g.name)}</h1>${styleHero(g)}<div class="tags">${g.traits.map(t=>`<span class="tag">${E(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div><h3>Why it happened</h3><p>${E(g.story)}</p><h3>Meet the makers</h3><p>${E(g.people)}</p><h3>What to explore</h3><p>${E(g.example)}</p><a href="${g.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read the museum source ↗</a></div><button class="primary" id="challenge">Play the 5-question gallery challenge</button><p class="muted">80% earns the gallery badge. Wrong answers explain what to notice.</p>`);$('#challenge').onclick=()=>startRound('gallery',id)}
function playMenu(){shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Play to discover</div><h1>What will you make today?</h1>${nav()}<div class="grid"><div class="card">${museumArt('met')}<h2>Museum wanderer</h2><p class="muted">Choose a famous museum and move between collection-backed learning rooms. Free browse or room quests.</p><button class="primary" data-route="museums">Choose a museum</button></div><div class="card">${pxArt('detective','Pixel-art magnifying glass over a landscape painting')}<h2>Style detective</h2><p class="muted">Use a visual clue and common traits to find the movement. Ten shuffled questions.</p><button class="primary" id="detective">Start spotting</button></div><div class="card">${pxArt('workshop','Pixel-art museum facade under construction with a crane')}<h2>Architecture workshop</h2><p class="muted">Choose the right structure and details for a museum facade. Watch your building change.</p><button class="primary" id="builder">Build a facade</button></div><div class="card">${pxArt('matching','Pixel-art portrait and landscape paintings with a star')}<h2>Who made it?</h2><p class="muted">Match four real public-domain paintings and prints to their artists. Earn discovery stars.</p><button class="primary" id="matching">Match the makers</button></div><div class="card">${pxArt('ladder','Pixel-art ladder of clue cards with a light bulb')}<h2>Clue ladder</h2><p class="muted">Five clues from broad to specific, 30 seconds, points fade every 6. Six choices, or type the answer once you clear choices 3 times.</p><button class="primary" id="ladder">Play the ladder</button></div><div class="card">${pxArt('timeline','Pixel-art timeline of three labels and a clock')}<h2>Time curator</h2><p class="muted">Arrange three museum labels by their dates. A quick hands-on timeline challenge.</p><button class="primary" id="timeline">Arrange the labels</button></div></div>`);$('#detective').onclick=()=>startRound('detective');$('#builder').onclick=()=>workshop();$('#matching').onclick=()=>startMatch();$('#ladder').onclick=ladderSetup;$('#timeline').onclick=timelineGame}
const materialChallenges={"3": ["Which format fits Ilkhanid book arts?", "Illustrated manuscripts", ["Steel-and-glass towers", "Concrete roads", "Oil on factory walls"], "Painters and calligraphers worked together in manuscript production."], "4": ["Which medium is central to this landscape tradition?", "Brush and ink", ["Cast bronze", "Cut glass", "Concrete casting"], "Chinese landscape painters use expressive brushwork as well as visual description."], "5": ["Which technique fits Benin court objects?", "Casting metal", ["Woodblock printing", "Oil painting only", "Glass curtain walls"], "Benin objects commonly called bronzes can include cast brass. The material label matters."], "21": ["Which material fits Hatshepsut\u2019s sphinx?", "Carved stone", ["Oil on paper", "Printed cloth", "Blown glass"], "The sphinx is a carved stone royal image combining human and animal forms."], "22": ["Which feature belongs to Greek architectural orders?", "Columns and their capitals", ["Projector screens", "Steel elevators", "Plastic light boxes"], "Doric and Ionic orders organize columns and the structural parts above them."], "23": ["Which materials appear in Greek and Roman sculpture?", "Marble and bronze", ["Only digital pixels", "Only knitted wool", "Only paper collage"], "Roman marble and bronze versions can preserve older Greek sculptural designs."], "24": ["Which material and technique fit Shiva Nataraja?", "Cast copper alloy", ["Oil on canvas", "Woodblock on paper", "Glass mosaic"], "The Met records this Chola-period image in copper alloy. The dance, halo and attributes carry meaning."], "25": ["Which built form is linked to Buddhist relics?", "A stupa", ["A civic guard hall", "A royal portrait frame", "A modern freeway"], "Stupas are relic monuments within Buddhist devotional traditions."], "26": ["Which technique fits a Maya royal relief?", "Carving stone", ["Printing newspapers", "Spray-painting steel", "Blowing glass"], "Maya sculptors worked stone and many other materials, including clay, wood, shell and bone."], "27": ["Which material can form a Hawaiian ipu hula?", "A gourd", ["A steel skyscraper beam", "An oil-paint canvas", "A marble portrait bust"], "The museum\u2019s Oceanic instrument examples include Hawaiian gourd drums. Materials differ by region."], "28": ["Which historical craft fits this Kongo chapter?", "Carving ivory", ["Photography only", "Concrete extrusion", "Industrial glass towers"], "The chapter studies historical ivory carving and its social history, not a recommendation to buy ivory."], "29": ["Which technique fits the Fatimid Bowl with Eagle?", "Luster-painted glazed earthenware", ["Oil paint on canvas", "Knitted silk only", "Cast concrete"], "The Met lists the Bowl with Eagle, ca. 1000, as earthenware, luster-painted on opaque white glaze. Other Fatimid crafts use different materials."], "30": ["Which materials fit Shah Jahan Album paintings?", "Ink, opaque watercolor and gold on paper", ["Cast bronze and granite", "Oil paint on concrete", "Knitted wool and steel"], "The Met lists these materials for many Shah Jahan Album folios. Painting and calligraphy are brought together with decorated borders."], "33": ["How can an installation be experienced?", "Moving through a space with objects or mixed media", ["Only reading the frame price", "Only measuring one brush", "Only checking a canvas signature"], "Installation can use the surrounding space and multiple media as part of the work."], "31": ["Which technique fits Nasreen Mohamedi\u2019s minimalist work?", "Ink drawing", ["Bronze casting", "Marble carving", "Glass blowing"], "The Met\u2019s modern India essay describes Mohamedi\u2019s minimalist ink drawings and reverberating lines. India\u2019s modern artists use many other media too."]};
function questions(g){let others=galleries.filter(x=>x.id!==g.id);let med=g.medium==='Architecture'?'Architecture':g.medium;return [
{q:g.q,a:g.a,opts:[g.a,...g.wrong],why:g.story},
{q:'Which trait belongs to '+g.name+'?',a:g.traits[0],opts:[g.traits[0],...shuffle(others.filter(x=>!x.traits.includes(g.traits[0]))).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.traits[0])],why:g.traits.join(', ')+'. '+g.story},
materialChallenges[g.id]?{q:materialChallenges[g.id][0],a:materialChallenges[g.id][1],opts:[materialChallenges[g.id][1],...materialChallenges[g.id][2]],why:materialChallenges[g.id][3]}:{q:'Which maker or workshop is linked to '+g.name+'?',a:g.people,opts:[g.people,...shuffle(others).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.people)],why:g.people+'. Not every movement has a single leader.'},
{q:'Where does this chapter focus?',a:g.region,opts:[g.region,...shuffle([...new Set(others.map(x=>x.region))].filter(x=>x!==g.region)).slice(0,3)],why:'This chapter focuses on '+g.region+'. Styles can travel beyond those borders.'},
{q:'Which set of clues belongs together?',a:g.traits.join(' • '),opts:[g.traits.join(' • '),...shuffle(others).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.traits.join(' • '))],why:g.story}].map(q=>({...q,gid:g.id,opts:shuffle(q.opts)}))}
function startRound(type,id){let qs=type==='gallery'?questions(galleries[id]):shuffle(galleries).slice(0,10).map(g=>({gid:g.id,q:'Which chapter fits these clues?',a:g.name,opts:shuffle([g.name,...shuffle(galleries.filter(x=>x.id!==g.id)).slice(0,3).map(x=>x.name)]),why:g.traits.join(', ')+'. '+g.story,clues:g.traits}));round={type,id,qs,i:0,score:0,answered:false};question()}

function quizVisual(g,q){let a=artworks.find(x=>x.id===quizArtworkMap[g.id]);let material=materialChallenges[g.id]&&q.q===materialChallenges[g.id][0];return `<figure class="quiz-art ${a?'real-art':'studio-art'}"><div class="art-stage"><img src="${a?a.img:studioImage}" alt="${a?E(a.title):'Imaginary art-making studio with paper, pigments and tools'}"/><span class="art-badge">${a?'THE MET · CC0':'NEON MAKER STUDIO'}</span><button id="artZoom" class="art-zoom" aria-label="Enlarge artwork" aria-expanded="false"><svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="6"/><path d="m15 15 6 6M10 7v6M7 10h6"/></svg></button></div><figcaption><b>${a?E(a.title):E(g.name)}</b><br><span>${a?'Image: The Met, Open Access, CC0.':'Original imaginary studio illustration, not a historical artwork.'}</span></figcaption>${material&&a?'<div class="look-note"><span class="look-dot"></span>Look closely at the surface, marks and details.</div>':''}</figure>`}
function question(){let r=round;if(r.i>=r.qs.length)return result();let q=r.qs[r.i],g=galleries[q.gid];shell(`<div class="quiz"><div class="row"><button class="ghost" data-route="play">Exit game</button><span class="tag">${r.i+1} / ${r.qs.length} · ${r.score} correct</span></div><div class="track"><i style="width:${r.i/r.qs.length*100}%"></i></div><div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">${r.type==='gallery'?'Gallery challenge':'Style detective'}</div>${quizVisual(g,q)}${q.clues?`<div class="tags">${q.clues.map(t=>`<span class="tag">${E(t)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:''}<h2>${E(q.q)}</h2><div id="answers">${q.opts.map((a,i)=>`<button class="choice visual-answer" data-answer="${i}"><span class="answer-letter">${String.fromCharCode(65+i)}</span><span>${E(a)}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><div id="feedback" aria-live="polite"></div></div></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-answer]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>answer(+b.dataset.answer));$('#artZoom').onclick=()=>{let f=document.querySelector('.quiz-art');let on=f.classList.toggle('enlarged');$('#artZoom').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(on))}}
function answer(i){let r=round;if(r.answered)return;r.answered=true;let q=r.qs[r.i],ok=q.opts[i]===q.a;if(ok)r.score++;document.querySelectorAll('[data-answer]').forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;if(q.opts[+b.dataset.answer]===q.a)b.classList.add('correct');else if(+b.dataset.answer===i)b.classList.add('wrong')});$('#feedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?'Good job!':'Keep exploring'}</h3><p>${ok?'You spotted it.':'The right answer: '+E(q.a)+'.'} ${E(q.why)}</p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="${galleries[q.gid].source}">Museum source ↗</a></div><button class="primary choice" id="next">${r.i===r.qs.length-1?'See my collection':'Next discovery →'}</button>`;$('#next').onclick=()=>{r.i++;r.answered=false;question()}}
function result(){let r=round,pct=Math.round(r.score/r.qs.length*100),earned=false,fromTrail=trailStop!=null;if(fromTrail&&pct>=80)trailMarkDone(trailStop);if(r.type==='gallery'&&pct>=80&&!state.badges.includes(r.id)){state.badges.push(r.id);earned=true}state.stars+=r.score;state.best.unshift({game:r.type==='gallery'?galleries[r.id].name:'Style detective',score:r.score,total:r.qs.length,pct});state.best=state.best.slice(0,20);save();shell(`<div class="card" style="text-align:center">${medalSvg()}<div class="eyebrow">Discovery complete</div><h1>${pct>=80?'Gallery star!':'A new way to see'}</h1><h2>${r.score} / ${r.qs.length} correct</h2><p>${earned?'A new gallery badge is yours.':r.type==='gallery'&&pct<80?'Score 80% to earn this badge. Every attempt helps you learn.':'Your discovery stars have been saved.'}</p><div class="buttons"><button class="primary" data-route="collection">My collection</button><button id="again">Play again</button></div>${fromTrail?'<button class="primary" data-route="trail">Back to the trail</button>':''}<button data-route="explore">Back to galleries</button></div>`);trailStop=null;$('#again').onclick=()=>startRound(r.type,r.id)}
function collection(){shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Your museum passport</div><h1>A growing collection</h1>${nav()}<div class="stats"><div><b>${state.badges.length} / ${galleries.length}</b><small>Gallery badges</small></div><div><b>${state.stars}</b><small>Discovery stars</small></div></div><div class="grid">${galleries.map(g=>`<div class="badge ${state.badges.includes(g.id)?'':'locked'}">${styleThumbnail(g)}<span><b>${E(g.name)}</b><div class="muted">${state.badges.includes(g.id)?'Collected':'Score 80% in this gallery'}</div></span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="card"><h2>Museum passport</h2><p>${(state.rooms||[]).length} / 9 room stamps collected.</p><button data-route="museums">Visit the museums</button><h2>Scores on this device</h2>${state.best.length?state.best.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.pct-a.pct).slice(0,10).map((r,i)=>`<p class="row"><span>${i+1}. ${E(r.game)}</span><b>${r.score}/${r.total} · ${r.pct}%</b></p>`).join(''):'<p class="muted">Your first discovery is waiting.</p>'}<p class="muted">Only your browser stores these scores. There is no online leaderboard.</p></div>`)}
const builds=[{name:'Gothic',arch:'Pointed arch',detail:'Rib vaults and stained glass',source:galleries[0].source},{name:'Renaissance',arch:'Classical portico',detail:'Symmetry and measured columns',source:galleries[1].source},{name:'Modernism',arch:'Flat roof and simple volumes',detail:'Functional open glass facade',source:galleries[17].source}];let target=0;
function workshop(reset=true){if(reset){target=Math.floor(Math.random()*3);build={arch:null,detail:null}}let b=builds[target];shell(`<button class="ghost" data-route="play">← Games</button><div class="eyebrow">Architecture workshop</div><h1>Build ${b.name}</h1><p class="muted">A playful schematic, not a structural design or a real building.</p><div class="card"><div id="facade">${facade()}</div><h3>1. Pick the structure</h3><div class="buttons">${builds.map((x,i)=>`<button data-arch="${i}">${x.arch}</button>`).join('')}</div><h3>2. Pick the details</h3>${shuffle(builds.map((x,i)=>({x,i}))).map(({x,i})=>`<button class="choice" data-detail="${i}">${x.detail}</button>`).join('')}<button class="primary choice" id="checkBuild">Open my museum</button><div id="buildFeedback" aria-live="polite"></div></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-arch]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{build.arch=+x.dataset.arch;$('#facade').innerHTML=facade();document.querySelectorAll('[data-arch]').forEach(y=>y.classList.toggle('correct',y===x))});document.querySelectorAll('[data-detail]').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{build.detail=+x.dataset.detail;$('#facade').innerHTML=facade();document.querySelectorAll('[data-detail]').forEach(y=>y.classList.toggle('correct',y===x))});$('#checkBuild').onclick=()=>{if(build.arch===null||build.detail===null){$('#buildFeedback').innerHTML='<p>Choose a structure and details first.</p>';return}let ok=build.arch===target&&build.detail===target;$('#buildFeedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?'Your museum is open!':'Try a different combination'}</h3><p>${b.name} pairs ${b.arch.toLowerCase()} with ${b.detail.toLowerCase()}.</p><a href="${b.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Architecture source ↗</a></div><button class="choice" id="newBuild">New design brief</button>`;if(ok){state.stars+=3;save();$('#checkBuild').disabled=true}$('#newBuild').onclick=()=>workshop()}}
function facade(){let a=build.arch,d=build.detail;let roof=a===0?'<path d="M70 68 140 24 210 68"/><path d="M105 146V93Q105 65 140 44Q175 65 175 93V146"/>':a===1?'<path d="M54 63 140 23 226 63Z"/>':'<path d="M50 50H230V66H50Z"/>';let detail=d===0?'<path d="M86 133V90Q100 68 114 90V133ZM165 133V90Q179 68 193 90V133Z" fill="#b7a2ff"/>':d===1?'<path d="M75 74V146M115 74V146M165 74V146M205 74V146" stroke-width="10"/>':'<path d="M74 78H207V140H74ZM74 107H207M110 78V140M170 78V140"/>';return `<svg class="illustration art-tall" viewBox="0 0 280 180" role="img" aria-label="Your museum facade"><rect x="5" y="5" width="270" height="170" rx="20" fill="#0c1732"/><g stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="5" fill="#263c61" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M64 69H218V152H64Z"/>${roof}${detail}<path d="M49 157H232" stroke="#80edbe"/></g><path d="M124 151V120Q141 94 157 120V151" fill="#80edbe"/><circle cx="244" cy="28" r="9" fill="#b7a2ff"/></svg>`}
function startMatch(){match={items:shuffle(artworks.slice(0,4)),i:0,score:0,done:false};matching()}
function matching(){let m=match;if(m.i>=m.items.length){state.stars+=m.score;save();return shell(`<div class="card"><h1>Makers discovered!</h1><h2>${m.score} / 4 matched</h2><p>Four public-domain works are now familiar faces in your museum.</p><button class="primary" id="rematch">Match again</button><button data-route="play">More games</button></div>`),$('#rematch').onclick=startMatch}let a=m.items[m.i];m.done=false;shell(`<button class="ghost" data-route="play">← Games</button><div class="eyebrow">Who made it? · ${m.i+1} / 4</div><h1>Meet the maker</h1><div class="card"><img class="art art-tall" src="${a.img}" alt="Artwork to identify"><p class="muted">Artwork from The Met’s Open Access collection. Artist and title revealed after your answer.</p><h2>Who created this work?</h2>${shuffle(artworks.slice(0,4).map(x=>x.artist)).map((n,i)=>`<button class="choice" data-maker="${E(n)}">${E(n)}</button>`).join('')}<div id="matchFeedback" aria-live="polite"></div></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-maker]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(m.done)return;m.done=true;let ok=b.dataset.maker===a.artist;if(ok)m.score++;document.querySelectorAll('[data-maker]').forEach(x=>{x.disabled=true;x.classList.add(x.dataset.maker===a.artist?'correct':x===b?'wrong':'disabled')});$('#matchFeedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?'Good job!':'A new artist to remember'}</h3><p><b>${E(a.title)}</b><br>${E(a.artist)}, ${E(a.date)}</p><p class="muted">${E(a.credit)}</p><a href="${a.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">See the museum record ↗</a></div><button class="choice primary" id="nextArt">Next artwork →</button>`;$('#nextArt').onclick=()=>{m.i++;matching()}})}

Route is a teaching sequence, not the museum floor plan.", "rooms": [{"name": "Egypt: rulers and temples", "gid": 21, "works": [544442, 547802], "hint": "Stone can express royal power and sacred architecture.", "q": "Which work is a building, not a freestanding figure?", "a": "The Temple of Dendur", "wrong": ["Sphinx of Hatshepsut", "The Milkmaid", "The Threatened Swan"], "why": "Dendur is an Egyptian temple, completed by 10 CE. The sphinx is a royal sculpture.", "location": "Met records list these Egyptian works in Gallery 131. Display labels can change.", "source": "https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/547802"}, {"name": "South Asia: the dancing god", "gid": 24, "works": [39328], "hint": "Look for the ring, gestures and attributes around the moving figure.", "q": "What surrounds Shiva’s dance?", "a": "A flaming halo", "wrong": ["A marble staircase", "An empty picture frame", "A civic guard"], "why": "The halo, drum, fire and gestures carry meanings related to creation, destruction and refuge.", "location": "Met record lists Shiva Nataraja in Gallery 240.", "source": "https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/39328"}, {"name": "Painting: a new view of nature", "gid": 12, "works": [437680, 436535], "hint": "Compare visible brushwork, color and the treatment of a landscape.", "q": "Who painted Wheat Field with Cypresses?", "a": "Vincent van Gogh", "wrong": ["Johannes Vermeer", "Rembrandt van Rijn", "Leonardo da Vinci"], "why": "Van Gogh painted this work in 1889. Sisley’s bridge landscape was made in 1872; their marks and color choices differ.", "location": "An educational painting room, not a claim that these works hang side by side.", "source": "https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436535"}]}, {"id": "louvre", "name": "Louvre Museum", "city": "Paris", "note": "Real collection works, original teaching diagrams. No Louvre photographs copied. Official site warns some collection room listings may be outdated.", "rooms": [{"name": "Greek sculpture: marble and identity", "gid": 23, "works": [], "title": "Venus de Milo", "artist": "Ancient Greek sculptor; name uncertain", "date": "Hellenistic period", "hint": "Drapery and a turned body can communicate movement even in still stone.", "q": "Which material is recorded for Venus de Milo?", "a": "Parian marble", "wrong": ["Painted cardboard", "Stainless steel", "Oil on canvas"], "why": "The Louvre record identifies Parian marble. Missing arms complicate identification of the figure.", "location": "Official palace page describes the Classical and Hellenistic Greek galleries. Treat room numbers as source labels, not navigation advice.", "source": "https://collections.louvre.fr/en/ark:/53355/cl010277627"}, {"name": "Victory: sculpture in motion", "gid": 23, "works": [], "title": "Winged Victory of Samothrace", "artist": "Ancient Greek sculptor; name not recorded", "date": "Probably c. 190 BCE", "hint": "Imagine fabric pressed by the wind and wings extending into space.", "q": "What does this figure personify?", "a": "Victory", "wrong": ["A milkmaid", "A pharaoh", "A civic guard captain"], "why": "The Louvre identifies the figure as the goddess of Victory, alighting on a ship after a sea battle.", "location": "Daru staircase, Room 703, Denon wing, Level 1 according to the official palace page.", "source": "https://musee.louvre.fr/en/explore/the-palace/a-stairway-to-victory"}, {"name": "Renaissance: a famous portrait", "gid": 2, "works": [], "title": "Mona Lisa", "artist": "Leonardo da Vinci", "date": "1503–1519, Louvre record range", "hint": "Think about portraiture, a seated figure and a landscape background.", "q": "Who made the Mona Lisa?", "a": "Leonardo da Vinci", "wrong": ["Hokusai", "Johannes Vermeer", "Claude Monet"], "why": "The Louvre attributes the portrait of Lisa Gherardini to Leonardo da Vinci.", "location": "Collection record labels Salle 711, Denon wing, Level 1; room metadata may change.", "source": "https://collections.louvre.fr/en/ark:/53355/cl010062370"}]}, {"id": "rijks", "name": "Rijksmuseum", "city": "Amsterdam", "note": "Real Dutch collection works, original teaching diagrams. Gallery route is invented for learning, not a copied floor plan.", "rooms": [{"name": "Everyday life: light and stillness", "gid": 6, "works": [], "title": "The Milkmaid", "artist": "Johannes Vermeer", "date": "c. 1660", "hint": "A quiet everyday action can become a carefully composed painting.", "q": "What action does the maid perform?", "a": "Pouring milk", "wrong": ["Playing a drum", "Leading a militia", "Carving marble"], "why": "The museum describes the stream of milk as the main moving element in an otherwise still scene.", "location": "Educational room inspired by the collection; not a current hanging claim.", "source": "https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/collection/object/The-Milkmaid--42dd0e658c2979aec8e144d2357c55c0"}, {"name": "Group portrait: people in action", "gid": 6, "works": [], "title": "The Night Watch", "artist": "Rembrandt van Rijn", "date": "1642", "hint": "A group portrait can show a company preparing to move, rather than standing in a static row.", "q": "What kind of group appears here?", "a": "Amsterdam’s civic guard", "wrong": ["A ballet company", "A group of pharaohs", "A printing workshop"], "why": "The museum identifies a civic guard company under Captain Frans Banninck Cocq.", "location": "The real Night Watch Gallery was specially designed to show this painting; our room drawing is schematic.", "source": "https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/collection/object/The-Night-Watch-Militia-Company-of-District-II-under-the-Command-of-Captain-Frans-Banninck-Cocq--3137deb45cd7765f9a76084a16c99544"}, {"name": "Animals: a dramatic moment", "gid": 6, "works": [], "title": "The Threatened Swan", "artist": "Jan Asselijn", "date": "c. 1650", "hint": "Observe pose, threat and the relationship between a bird and its surroundings.", "q": "Which animal is the subject?", "a": "A swan", "wrong": ["A lion", "A horse", "A whale"], "why": "Jan Asselijn painted a swan defending its nest. Later inscriptions gave the picture a political interpretation.", "location": "Educational collection room, not a current hanging claim.", "source": "https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/collection/object/The-Threatened-Swan--22040f90565e730131983a44a85b989f"}]}];let museum=null,roomIndex=0,museumMode='browse',roomSolved=false;
function chapterArt(id){let map={1:698054,21:544442,24:39328};let a=artworks.find(x=>x.id===map[id]);return a?`<figure style="margin:12px 0"><img class="art art-tall" src="${a.img}" alt="${E(a.title)}"><figcaption class="muted">${E(a.title)} · ${E(a.date)}<br>Image: The Met, Open Access, CC0.</figcaption><a href="${a.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Actual collection work ↗</a></figure>`:''}
function museumSelector(){route='museums';shell(`<div class="eyebrow">Museum adventures</div><h1>Where will you wander?</h1><p>Pick a museum, then walk from room to room. Explore freely or take a detective challenge in every room.</p>${nav()}<div class="buttons"><button id="browseMuseum" class="${museumMode==='browse'?'primary':''}">Free browse</button><button id="challengeMuseum" class="${museumMode==='quest'?'primary':''}">Room challenges</button></div><div class="grid">${museums.map(m=>`<button class="card museum-card" data-museum="${m.id}">${museumArt(m.id)}<h2>${E(m.name)}</h2><p class="muted">${E(m.city)} · ${m.rooms.length} learning rooms</p><span class="tag">${m.id==='met'?'Real CC0 collection images':'Original diagrams + real work records'}</span></button>`).join('')}</div><footer>Original educational rooms and routes, not museum floor plans. These games are not affiliated with the museums. Work details are sourced to each museum’s own collection records. Display locations may change.</footer>`);$('#browseMuseum').onclick=()=>{museumMode='browse';museumSelector()};$('#challengeMuseum').onclick=()=>{museumMode='quest';museumSelector()};document.querySelectorAll('[data-museum]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{trailRoom=false;museum=museums.find(m=>m.id===b.dataset.museum);roomIndex=0;roomView()})}
function roomMap(){return `<div class="room-map" aria-label="Schematic learning route">${museum.rooms.map((r,i)=>`<button class="room-door ${i===roomIndex?'current':''}" data-room="${i}"><span>${i===roomIndex?paPawn():i+1}</span><small>${i===roomIndex?'You are here':(state.rooms||[]).includes(museum.id+'-'+i)?'Stamp earned':'Enter room'}</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`}
function artWall(r){if(r.works.length)return `<div class="room-art">${r.works.map(id=>{let a=artworks.find(x=>x.id===id);return `<figure><img class="art art-tall" src="${a.img}" alt="${museumMode==='quest'?'Collection work for the room challenge':E(a.title)}"><figcaption class="muted">${museumMode==='browse'?E(a.title)+'<br>'+E(a.artist)+', '+E(a.date):'A work from this museum’s collection. Title revealed after the challenge.'}</figcaption>${museumMode==='browse'?`<p class="muted">Image: The Met, Open Access, CC0.</p><a href="${a.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Collection record ↗</a>`:''}</figure>`}).join('')}</div>`;return `<div class="room-display">${objectDiagram(r.title)}<p class="muted">Original learning illustration, not a reproduction or photograph of the named work.</p>${museumMode==='browse'?`<h2>${E(r.title)}</h2><p>${E(r.artist)} · ${E(r.date)}</p>`:''}</div>`}
function objectDiagram(title){let shapes=title.includes('Mona')||title.includes('Milk')?'<rect x="66" y="14" width="146" height="130" rx="9" fill="#20385b"/><path d="M103 130Q94 86 141 80Q187 86 181 130" fill="#b7a2ff"/><circle cx="140" cy="55" r="24" fill="#80edbe"/><path d="M117 43Q141 8 164 43" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="8"/><path d="M138 89 192 116" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="9"/>':title.includes('Swan')?'<path d="M96 117Q40 71 98 55Q151 45 201 97Q228 110 219 127Q152 148 96 117" fill="#b7a2ff"/><path d="M183 93Q232 29 187 30Q163 34 184 58" stroke="#80edbe" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/><path d="M111 80 67 30 145 100" fill="#74d7ff"/>':title.includes('Night')?'<g fill="#80edbe"><circle cx="89" cy="48" r="14"/><circle cx="140" cy="34" r="15"/><circle cx="192" cy="48" r="14"/></g><g stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="9"><path d="M89 68V125M140 57V133M192 67V122M75 98 185 84"/></g>':'<path d="M106 142 120 87Q93 61 113 36Q140 17 160 40Q174 65 151 88L174 142Z" fill="#b7a2ff" stroke="#74d7ff" stroke-width="3"/>'+ (title.includes('Victory')?'<path d="M110 78 57 32 75 96M158 79 220 31 199 102" fill="#80edbe"/>':'');return `<svg class="illustration" viewBox="0 0 280 165" role="img" aria-label="Original schematic teaching diagram"><rect x="3" y="3" width="274" height="159" rx="21" fill="#0d1732" stroke="#46618b"/>${shapes}</svg>`}
function roomView(){let r=museum.rooms[roomIndex];roomSolved=false;let opts=shuffle([r.a,...r.wrong]);shell(`<button class="ghost" id="leaveMuseum">← Museums</button>${trailRoom?'<button class="ghost" id="leaveTrail">← Trail board</button>':''}<div class="eyebrow">${E(museum.name)} · Room ${roomIndex+1} of ${museum.rooms.length}</div><h1>${E(r.name)}</h1>${roomMap()}<div class="card"><p class="muted">${E(museum.note)}</p>${artWall(r)}<p>${E(r.hint)}</p><details><summary>Room source & real-world location</summary><p class="muted">${E(r.location)}</p><a href="${r.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Official museum source ↗</a><p class="muted">Met images: CC0 Open Access. Other museum rooms: original diagrams; no rights-restricted photographs used.</p></details>${museumMode==='quest'?`<h2>${E(r.q)}</h2>${opts.map((a,i)=>`<button class="choice" data-room-answer="${i}">${E(a)}</button>`).join('')}<div id="roomFeedback" aria-live="polite"></div>`:`<button id="roomChallenge" class="primary">Try this room’s challenge</button>`}</div><div class="buttons"><button id="prevRoom" ${roomIndex===0?'disabled':''}>← Previous room</button><button class="primary" id="nextRoom">${roomIndex===museum.rooms.length-1?'Finish visit':'Next room →'}</button></div><button id="roomLesson" class="ghost">Learn the related style</button><p class="muted">Browse mode never locks doors. Challenge stamps are collected on this device.</p>`);$('#leaveMuseum').onclick=museumSelector;if(trailRoom&&$('#leaveTrail'))$('#leaveTrail').onclick=()=>{trailRoom=false;trailBoard()};$('#prevRoom').onclick=()=>{roomIndex--;roomView()};$('#nextRoom').onclick=()=>{if(roomIndex<museum.rooms.length-1){roomIndex++;roomView()}else finishMuseum()};$('#roomLesson').onclick=()=>lesson(r.gid);document.querySelectorAll('[data-room]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{roomIndex=+b.dataset.room;roomView()});if(museumMode==='browse')$('#roomChallenge').onclick=()=>{museumMode='quest';roomView()};else document.querySelectorAll('[data-room-answer]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{if(roomSolved)return;roomSolved=true;let ok=opts[+b.dataset.roomAnswer]===r.a;document.querySelectorAll('[data-room-answer]').forEach(x=>{x.disabled=true;x.classList.toggle('correct',opts[+x.dataset.roomAnswer]===r.a);x.classList.toggle('wrong',x===b&&!ok)});if(ok){state.rooms=state.rooms||[];let k=museum.id+'-'+roomIndex;if(!state.rooms.includes(k)){state.rooms.push(k);state.stars+=2;save();trailSyncMuseum()}}$('#roomFeedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?'Room stamp earned!':'A discovery to keep'}</h3><p>${ok?'':'The right answer: '+E(r.a)+'. '}${E(r.why)}</p>${r.title?`<p><b>${E(r.title)}</b><br>${E(r.artist)}, ${E(r.date)}</p>`:r.works.map(id=>artworks.find(a=>a.id===id)).filter(Boolean).map(a=>`<p><b>${E(a.title)}</b><br>${E(a.artist)}, ${E(a.date)}<br>Image: The Met, Open Access, CC0.</p>`).join('')}<a href="${r.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">See the real collection record ↗</a></div>`})}
function finishMuseum(){let n=(state.rooms||[]).filter(x=>x.startsWith(museum.id+'-')).length;shell(`<div class="card"><div class="eyebrow">Visit complete</div><h1>Your ${E(museum.name)} passport</h1>${museumArt(museum.id)}<h2>${n} / ${museum.rooms.length} room stamps</h2><p>${n===museum.rooms.length?'Every room challenge solved. Your visit is a museum memory!':'You can revisit any room freely or earn more stamps.'}</p><div class="buttons"><button class="primary" id="moreMuseums">Another museum</button><button data-route="collection">My collection</button></div></div>`);$('#moreMuseums').onclick=museumSelector}
function timelineGame(){let candidates=galleries.filter(g=>/^(?:c\. )?[12][0-9]{3}/.test(g.dates));let byYear=new Map(candidates.map(g=>[+g.dates.match(/[12][0-9]{3}/)[0],g]));let picked=shuffle([...byYear.values()]).slice(0,3),sorted=picked.slice().sort((a,b)=>+a.dates.match(/[12][0-9]{3}/)[0]-+b.dates.match(/[12][0-9]{3}/)[0]);let pending=picked.slice(),ordered=[];function view(){shell(`<button class="ghost" data-route="play">← Games</button><div class="eyebrow">Time curator</div><h1>Put the labels in time order</h1><p class="muted">Earliest start date first. Dates below are approximate chapter guides; styles overlap.</p><div class="card"><h3>Your display order</h3>${ordered.length?ordered.map((g,i)=>`<p>${i+1}. ${E(g.name)} · ${E(g.dates)}</p>`).join(''):'<p class="muted">Tap a label to place it.</p>'}${pending.map(g=>`<button class="choice" data-time="${g.id}">${E(g.name)} · ${E(g.dates)}</button>`).join('')}<div id="timeFeedback" aria-live="polite"></div><button class="choice" id="resetTime">Reset labels</button></div>`);document.querySelectorAll('[data-time]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let g=pending.find(g=>g.id===+b.dataset.time);ordered.push(g);pending=pending.filter(x=>x.id!==g.id);view();if(!pending.length){let ok=ordered.every((g,i)=>g.id===sorted[i].id);$('#timeFeedback').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback ${ok?'':'error'}"><h3>${ok?'Display ready!':'Check the date labels'}</h3><p>${sorted.map(g=>E(g.name)+' ('+E(g.dates)+')').join(' → ')}</p><p>Dates overlap; this is ordering labels, not claiming one worldwide sequence.</p></div>`;if(ok){state.stars++;save()}}});$('#resetTime').onclick=timelineGame}view()}

let initial=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('view');if(initial==='lesson')lesson(15);else if(initial==='quiz')startRound('detective');else if(initial==='build')workshop();else if(initial==='match')startMatch();else go(initial||'home');
</script></body></html>
